name: Prism Garden
title: Prism Garden restored.
story: A sleeping prism wakes. Follow its light above the clouds.

name: Cloud Carnival
title: Cloud Carnival restored.
story: The carnival lights flicker. A city below needs your spark.

name: Electric City
title: Electric City restored.
story: Power returns to the skyline. A hidden passage opens beneath it.

name: Crystal Caverns
title: Crystal Caverns restored.
story: The cavern opens in a shower of crystals. Warmth waits beyond.

name: Ember Foundry
title: Ember Foundry restored.
story: The forge releases its last ember. The world turns to ice.

name: Frost Observatory
title: Frost Observatory restored.
story: The telescope finds a signal. An ocean of stars answers.

name: Cosmic Reef
title: Cosmic Reef restored.
story: A river of stars carries the fragments to the citadel.

name: Prism Citadel
title: Prism Citadel restored.
story: The prism opens. Eight forgotten worlds answer its call.

name: Sunken Archive
title: Sunken Archive restored.
story: Lost constellations rise from the deep. Their light points north.

name: Aurora Passage
title: Aurora Passage restored.
story: The aurora folds into a bridge. A forest of turning gears awaits.

name: Clockwork Canopy
title: Clockwork Canopy restored.
story: A thousand mechanisms turn as one. Sand begins to shine.

name: Mirage Dunes
title: Mirage Dunes restored.
story: The mirage becomes a doorway. Thunder gathers on the other side.

name: Thunder Spire
title: Thunder Spire restored.
story: The storm splits. A quiet moon rises above the harbor.

name: Lunar Harbor
title: Lunar Harbor restored.
story: The last ship leaves its mooring. Beyond it, a star falls inward.

name: Event Horizon
title: Event Horizon restored.
story: You cross the darkness. On the far side, every color is waiting.

name: Dawn Nexus
title: You brought the dawn.
story: Sixteen worlds. One unbroken light. You brought the dawn.
